desc: Ideate and define the core approach (Segment Tree with min/max tracking and lazy propagation).
`build(node, start, end)`: Initialize leaves such that `tree_min[leaf] = tree_max[leaf] = initial_rating`.
`push(node)`: Propagate `lazy` value to children and update their `min`/`max`.
Pruning: If `tree_max[node] < l` or `tree_min[node] > r`, return.
Full Coverage: If `tree_min[node] >= l` and `tree_max[node] <= r`, apply lazy update, update `min`/`max`, return.
Partial: Push lazy, recurse left/right, then update current node's `min`/`max` from children.
Process each contest by calling `update` on the segment tree.
